scope: Software/offline-bundle forward/backward compatibility and actionable update direction. No platform coverage extension, dependency rebuild, online publishing or hosting migration.
changes: Accept catalogs whose fully validated declared roots include the application requirements. All profiles and referenced object metadata remain validated; extra roots do not alter caller-selected installation requests.
Missing current required roots produce BundleCoverageUnavailable with update-offline-bundle wording, including incomparable root sets rather than strict subsets only.
Newer schema or signed min_app_version above the runtime application version produces update-application wording. Missing minimum remains backward-compatible; invalid declarations fail closed.
Publishing preparation accepts --min-app-version, signs it in the existing schema-1 manifest, respects a catalog minimum and refuses changing compatibility requirements on an existing signed retry.

compatibility.desktop: Shared Python logic; executed on Windows. Debian runtime not available.
compatibility.router: No remote command, package-manager selection or requested-root policy changed. Existing exact release/target/architecture matching remains. Installation on hardware not performed.
compatibility.schema: Manifest schema and catalog schema remain 1. Compatibility minimum is optional and protected by existing signatures/catalog hash.
compatibility.legacy_clients: Already distributed old programs retain their old equality checks and cannot gain the fix without an application update.

thread_coordination.title: 排查依赖安装失败原因
thread_coordination.division: That thread checks missing platforms and archive sizes; this thread changes client compatibility and update messages. File overlap was explicitly communicated.

current_client_constraints: Downloads do not blindly follow redirects

followup.priority: Hosting migration deferred; platform/size audit continues in the coordinated conversation. This conversation completed independent compatibility follow-up.
followup.new_failure_reproduced: A failed minimum-version client check left a signed preparation manifest. The new regression failed before the fix.
followup.fix: Verify signed manifest bytes before writing the preparation file. No publication occurs on failure.
followup.coverage_messages: Both exact-match and candidate-profile failures now advise checking offline bundle updates and explain that an uncovered latest bundle needs the corresponding firmware combination collected.
followup.deployment: Source only. No online change, no offline package replacement, no app restart.
